name: Out of Stock!
description:
About This Game

Out of Stock! is a frantic cooperative party game for 1 to 4 players. Team up with your friends and step into the shoes of overwhelmed sellers. Order new stock, refill the shelves, clean up spills and check out customers fast, before they get angry and storm out !

Cooperative (in)experienced sellers

Divide the work efficiently with your friends, manage your time to serve as many customers as possible and throw boxes around to stay ahead of the chaos. But most importantly : NEVER do anything that could upset a customer.

Crazy customers

Customers are your top priority, so don't let them have a bad shopping experience ! Make sure the shelves are always stocked, and the floors are spotless. Each customer has a unique trait : Some take a lot of articles at once, some fall easily on dirty floor, while others get angry fast, really fast.

Customize your seller

Choose your style with dozens of different hats, haircuts and skin tones. Create your perfect store clerk and get ready to charm your customers !

New worlds to visit

Put your teamwork to the test in a variety of environments, each with its own challenges. Adapt your strategy to conveyor belts, tricky store layouts, demanding customers, and more!
short_desc: Team up with your friends in this frantic 4-player co-op party game! Order, restock, scrub the floor, but most importantly, keep your customers happy, or chaos will invade your store!
